ledger: Kitchen: light-wood cabinets, granite counters, microwave, stove with range hood, sink under a bare window; a wide cased opening in one wall leads out

Hallway: runs from the kitchen opening toward a white glass-paneled front door with sheer curtain at its far end; framed flower picture plus a second lighter framed picture on one wall; flush-mount ceiling light
Opening kitchen-to-hallway: from kitchen side it shows the hallway with flower picture and front door beyond; from hallway side it shows the kitchen stove, hood, and sink window

Bedroom: entered by a right turn off the hallway; dark-wood bed with white bedding, chandelier, nightstand with lamp and framed photo, art above bed, dresser, wooden chair, windows with beige curtains on two walls
Traversal 1 (~0:00-0:02): woman walks from kitchen through cased opening into hallway; view through opening matches established far side
Traversal 2 (~0:02-0:06): woman walks down hallway (front door passing on her left) and turns right through a doorway into the bedroom; consistent with hallway geometry

Traversal 3 (~0:06-0:09): woman crosses the bedroom toward a second doorway; through it is a corridor with a framed picture on the left wall, a flush ceiling light, and a bright multi-pane window at the far end, matching the view back along the hallway toward the kitchen's bright sink window

Furniture check: bed with adjacent nightstand/lamp, dresser, and chair all serve bedroom functions; kitchen fixtures (stove, sink, microwave) are correctly arranged along the counter run; no misoriented fixtures observed
